proof_body:
by
  intro F c r R M hrR hd hb
  have hρ : 0 < (R - r) / 2 := by linarith
  have hsub : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, Metric.closedBall x ((R - r) / 2) ⊆ Metric.ball c R := by
    intro x hx y hy
    have h1 := mem_closedBall_iff_norm.mp hx
    have h2 := mem_closedBall_iff_norm.mp hy
    rw [mem_ball_iff_norm]
    have h3 : ‖y - c‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ + ‖x - c‖ := by
      have := norm_add_le (y - x) (x - c)
      simpa using this
    linarith
  have hball : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, x ∈ Metric.ball c R := fun x hx => hsub x hx (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hρ.le)
  have hlip : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, ∀ y ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, ‖F n x - F n y‖ ≤ 2 * |M| / (R - r) * ‖x - y‖ := by
    intro n x hx y hy
    have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, ‖deriv (F n) x‖ ≤ 2 * |M| / (R - r) := by
      intro x hx
      have hdc : DiffContOnCl ℂ (F n) (Metric.ball x ((R - r) / 2)) := by
        apply DifferentiableOn.diffContOnCl
        rw [closure_ball x hρ.ne']
        exact (hd n).mono (hsub x hx)
      have := Complex.norm_deriv_le_of_forall_mem_sphere_norm_le hρ hdc (C := |M|) (fun y hy => (hb n y (hsub x hx (Metric.sphere_subset_closedBall hy))).trans (le_abs_self M))
      refine this.trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      have hne : R - r ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp
    have hdiff : ∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall c r, DifferentiableAt ℂ (F n) x := fun x hx => (hd n).differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds (hball x hx))
    exact Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le hdiff hderiv (convex_closedBall c r) hy hx
  have hLn : 0 ≤ 2 * |M| / (R - r) := by
    apply div_nonneg (by positivity); linarith
  let α := Metric.closedBall c r
  haveI : CompactSpace α := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp (isCompact_closedBall c r)
  let B : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction α ℂ := fun n =>
    BoundedContinuousFunction.mkOfCompact ⟨fun x => F n x.1, ((hd n).continuousOn.mono (fun x hx => hball x hx)).restrict⟩
  have hBapp : ∀ n x, B n x = F n x.1 := fun n x => rfl
  have hin : ∀ (f : BoundedContinuousFunction α ℂ) (x : α), f ∈ Set.range B → f x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) M := by
    rintro _ x ⟨n, rfl⟩
    rw [hBapp, mem_closedBall_zero_iff]
    exact hb n x.1 (hball x.1 x.2)
  have hEq : Equicontinuous ((↑) : Set.range B → α → ℂ) := by
    have : ∀ i : Set.range B, LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal (2 * |M| / (R - r))) (i : α → ℂ) := by
      rintro ⟨_, n, rfl⟩
      refine LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul (fun x y => ?_)
      rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hLn, dist_eq_norm, Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
      exact hlip n x.1 x.2 y.1 y.2
    exact (LipschitzWith.uniformEquicontinuous _ _ this).equicontinuous
  have hcomp := BoundedContinuousFunction.arzela_ascoli (Metric.closedBall (0 : ℂ) M) (isCompact_closedBall 0 M) (Set.range B) hin hEq
  obtain ⟨a, _, φ, hφ, hlim⟩ := hcomp.tendsto_subseq (x := B) (fun n => subset_closure ⟨n, rfl⟩)
  classical
  refine ⟨φ, fun z => if h : z ∈ Metric.closedBall c r then a ⟨z, h⟩ else 0, hφ, ?_⟩
  rw [Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff]
  intro ε hε
  have h1 := (Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hlim) ε hε
  filter_upwards [h1] with n hn x hx
  have h2 := lt_of_le_of_lt (BoundedContinuousFunction.dist_coe_le_dist (f := (B ∘ φ) n) (g := a) ⟨x, hx⟩) hn
  rw [dist_comm]
  simpa [hx, hBapp] using h2
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r R M : ℝ), r < R → (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F n) (Metric.ball c R)) → (∀ n, ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R, ‖F n x‖ ≤ M) → ∃ (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (g : ℂ → ℂ), StrictMono φ ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn (fun n => F (φ n)) g Filter.atTop (Metric.closedBall c r)
